model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of Multilingual T5 Large models across English and other languages, specifically focusing on their ability to perform fact-checking. The horizontal axis represents languages, ordered alphabetically from “Arabic” to “Welsh,” and the vertical axis displays the model’s performance, measured as “Relative Performance,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100. The scale is marked with tick labels every 10 units, indicating increments of 10.  There are nine bars, each representing a different language, and their heights vary significantly. The bar for “English” reaches a height of 85, while the bar for “Welsh” measures 60.  The bars for “Arabic,” “Chinese,” “Russian,” “French,” “German,” “Spanish,” and “Italian” have heights of 75, 70, 65, 60, 55, 50, and 45, respectively.  All bars are of the same color, representing a consistent level of performance across all languages represented in the chart.
